instruction: Search for the Momentum extension in the Chrome Web Store and open its detail page.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent read plugin list document, switched to Chrome, navigated to Chrome Web Store, searched for 'Zoom Chrome Extension', found and opened its detail page, clicked 'Add to Chrome', but installation was blocked with 'Installation is not enabled' error. Agent stayed on the Zoom extension page for remaining turns, never attempted other plugins.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can read documents in LibreOffice Writer, switch between applications, navigate to Chrome Web Store, search for extensions by name, click on search results to open extension detail pages, interact with 'Add to Chrome' button and permission dialogs
metadata.failure_analysis: Extension installation is disabled in the VM environment. The model got stuck after the first 'Installation is not enabled' error on Zoom Chrome Extension and did not attempt any of the other 4 plugins. The model lacked error recovery strategy.
metadata.task_rationale: Decomposed original multi-plugin installation task into a single navigation task. Model demonstrated it can search and find extension pages. This variation tests finding Momentum, a productivity/new-tab extension with a single-word search term.
metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating from the initial LibreOffice Writer view to Chrome Web Store and finding the Momentum extension detail page. Evaluator checks the active tab URL matches the Momentum extension detail page pattern using regex.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter 'active_url_from_accessTree' correctly extracts the active Chrome tab URL from the accessibility tree, which is the right state to check for this navigation task.
Metric 'is_expected_url_pattern_match' correctly performs regex matching on the URL against expected patterns, and correctly accesses rules['expected'] (proper parameter handling for type='rule').

Expected regex pattern 'chromewebstore\.google\.com/detail/momentum' correctly matches Chrome Web Store detail page URLs for the Momentum extension (e.g., chromewebstore.google.com/detail/momentum/<id>).

Coverage is complete: the instruction requires searching and opening the detail page. Verifying the final URL is sufficient end-state verification since a correct detail page URL implies the search and navigation were successful.
Data flow is correct: getter extracts URL string -> metric applies regex pattern -> pattern matches Momentum extension detail page.
